class.name: InputIconSet
class.brief_description: Custom icons per key, mouse button, gamepad button and gamepad axis direction.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all icons, including the fallback icons.

method.name: get_fallback_icon
method.description: Returns the fallback icon of the event's type ([member fallback_key_icon], [member fallback_mouse_button_icon], [member fallback_joy_button_icon] or [member fallback_joy_axis_icon]), or [code]null[/code] for other event types.

method.name: get_icon
method.description: Returns the icon of the event's key, mouse button, gamepad button or axis direction. If there is none and [param use_fallback] is [code]true[/code], returns the fallback icon of the event's type. Returns [code]null[/code] if there is no icon. Modifiers and the device of the event are ignored. For keys, the physical keycode is used, else the keycode, else the key label.

method.name: get_icon_for_text
method.description: Like [method get_icon] for the event of a text form of [method InputAction.text_to_event], for example [code]"Keyboard:Space"[/code], [code]"Gamepad:A"[/code] or [code]"GamepadAxis:LeftStickLeft"[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the text is not valid.

method.name: get_joy_axis_icon
method.description: Returns the icon of a gamepad axis direction, or [code]null[/code]. Only the sign of [param direction] counts: below [code]0.0[/code] is the negative direction (left or up on a stick).

method.name: get_joy_button_icon
method.description: Returns the icon of a gamepad button, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_key_icon
method.description: Returns the icon of a key, or [code]null[/code]. Modifier masks in [param key] are ignored.

method.name: get_mouse_button_icon
method.description: Returns the icon of a mouse button, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_icon
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the set has an icon for the event's key, button or axis direction (fallback icons do not count).

method.name: set_joy_axis_icon
method.description: Sets the icon of a gamepad axis direction; [code]null[/code] removes it. Only the sign of [param direction] counts. Triggers only use the positive direction.

method.name: set_joy_button_icon
method.description: Sets the icon of a gamepad button; [code]null[/code] removes it.

method.name: set_key_icon
method.description: Sets the icon of a key; [code]null[/code] removes it. Modifier masks in [param key] are ignored.

method.name: set_mouse_button_icon
method.description: Sets the icon of a mouse button; [code]null[/code] removes it.

members.member: Icon for gamepad axis directions without an own icon.
Icon for gamepad buttons without an own icon.
Icon for keys without an own icon.
Icon for mouse buttons without an own icon.

The icons of the gamepad axis directions, keyed by the direction names of [method InputAction.event_to_text] ([code]"LeftStickLeft"[/code], [code]"LeftStickRight"[/code], [code]"LeftStickUp"[/code], [code]"LeftStickDown"[/code], the same for [code]RightStick[/code], [code]"LeftTrigger"[/code], [code]"RightTrigger"[/code]). Setting it replaces all axis icons; unknown names are reported and skipped.

The icons of the gamepad buttons, keyed by the button names of [method InputAction.event_to_text] ([code]"A"[/code], [code]"LeftStickPress"[/code], [code]"DPadUp"[/code], ...). [enum JoyButton] values are accepted as keys when it is set.

The icons of the keys, keyed by the key names of [method InputAction.event_to_text] ([code]"Space"[/code], [code]"A"[/code], [code]"Escape"[/code], ...). [enum Key] values are accepted as keys when it is set.

The icons of the mouse buttons, keyed by the button names of [method InputAction.event_to_text] ([code]"Left"[/code], [code]"Right"[/code], [code]"WheelUp"[/code], ...). [enum MouseButton] values are accepted as keys when it is set.
